releaseNotes: Welcome Light now consumes the hardware-current preset verified by its upstream Signal Tower Config instead of overwriting it with builtin.welcomeLevel. User-defined Welcome colours/segments therefore remain authoritative across cold start and reconnect.

Signal Tower Config nodes feeding Welcome Light require current hardware projection verification before ENO. Historical trusted verification alone cannot start the Welcome cycle when a different recipe is physically active.

The six-second Welcome timer controls only the PDO level wave. Reconnect/restart rearms the startup cycle through SYSTEM READY and R_TRIG; Alarm preemption restores the same selected Welcome recipe before resuming.

Legacy projects that connect Welcome Light without an upstream Signal Tower Config retain builtin.welcomeLevel as a compatibility fallback. V880 live-wire polish and all V879/V878/V877 protections remain intact.

en: Welcome Light uses the hardware-current preset verified by the upstream Signal Tower Config; it no longer overwrites a user Welcome preset with builtin.welcomeLevel.
A Welcome-source Signal Tower Config must match the current hardware projection before ENO can start the six-second PDO level wave.
Reconnect/restart rearms the same startup sequence, while legacy direct Welcome Light projects keep builtin.welcomeLevel as fallback.
ko: Welcome Light는 상위 Signal Tower Config가 실제 하드웨어에 검증한 사용자 Welcome 프리셋을 그대로 사용하며 builtin.welcomeLevel로 다시 덮어쓰지 않습니다.
Welcome을 공급하는 Signal Tower Config는 과거 trusted 상태가 아니라 현재 하드웨어 projection까지 일치해야 ENO를 출력하고 6초 PDO level wave를 시작합니다.
재연결/재시작 시 동일 startup sequence가 다시 rearm되며, 상위 Config가 없는 구형 Welcome Light만 builtin.welcomeLevel을 fallback으로 사용합니다.
ja: Welcome Light は上流 Signal Tower Config が実ハードウェアで検証したユーザー Welcome preset をそのまま使用し、builtin.welcomeLevel で上書きしません。
Welcome source の Signal Tower Config は過去の trust だけでなく current hardware projection が一致してから ENO を出し、6 秒 PDO level wave を開始します。
再接続/再起動では同じ startup sequence が再 arm され、上流 Config のない legacy Welcome Light のみ builtin.welcomeLevel を fallback 使用します。
zh-CN: Welcome Light 直接使用上游 Signal Tower Config 已在真实硬件验证的用户 Welcome preset，不再用 builtin.welcomeLevel 覆盖。
作为 Welcome 来源的 Signal Tower Config 必须与当前硬件 projection 一致后才能输出 ENO 并启动 6 秒 PDO level wave。
重新连接/重启会重新使能同一 startup sequence；只有没有上游 Config 的旧版 Welcome Light 才回退到 builtin.welcomeLevel。
de: Welcome Light verwendet das vom vorgelagerten Signal Tower Config auf der aktuellen Hardware verifizierte Benutzer-Welcome-Preset und überschreibt es nicht mehr mit builtin.welcomeLevel.
Ein Welcome-Quellblock Signal Tower Config muss zur aktuellen Hardware-Projektion passen, bevor ENO die sechssekündige PDO-Level-Welle startet.
Reconnect/Restart armiert dieselbe Startup-Sequenz erneut; nur Legacy-Welcome-Light ohne vorgelagerten Config-Block verwendet builtin.welcomeLevel als Fallback.
es: Welcome Light usa el preset Welcome de usuario verificado en el hardware actual por el Signal Tower Config anterior y ya no lo sobrescribe con builtin.welcomeLevel.
El Signal Tower Config que alimenta Welcome debe coincidir con la proyección actual del hardware antes de emitir ENO e iniciar la onda PDO de nivel de seis segundos.
Reconnect/restart vuelve a armar la misma secuencia de arranque; solo los proyectos legacy sin Config anterior usan builtin.welcomeLevel como fallback.
